##### Project general facts

Hawana Salalah – Amazi is an exclusive oceanfront community set within the breathtaking natural landscape of southern Oman, where verdant wadis, pristine beaches, and the calm waters of the Indian Ocean create a truly unique coastal retreat. As the most premium residential offering within Hawana Salalah, Amazi spans more than one million square meters of lagoons, sandy shores, and lush green surroundings, offering a refined lifestyle immersed in nature. Designed as a year-round destination, the community provides a cool and refreshing escape during the Khareef season and a warm, sunlit sanctuary in winter, making it an exceptional setting for both leisure and permanent living.

The development features a diverse collection of villas and chalets thoughtfully positioned across several distinctive neighborhoods, including hillside homes with sweeping sea views, lagoon-front residences with private jetties, and beachfront villas with direct access to the sand. Residents enjoy a harmonious balance of privacy, comfort, and connection to the surrounding landscape, with seamless access to the wider Hawana Salalah lifestyle and amenities. This carefully planned environment creates a serene yet vibrant community where nature, luxury, and coastal living come together effortlessly.

Each residence is finished with high-quality contemporary materials that complement the natural elegance of the destination while offering modern comfort and durability. The homes feature fully equipped kitchens and are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners the flexibility to personalize their interiors and create a living space that reflects their own style within this exceptional waterfront setting.

##### Location description and benefits

Hawana Salalah is the largest and most prestigious integrated tourism and residential community in southern Oman. Situated along 7 kilometers of pristine white sandy beaches and surrounded by lush greenery, it offers an idyllic coastal lifestyle where nature meets modern luxury. With its year-round tropical climate and breathtaking natural beauty, it has become a sought-after destination for residents, tourists, and investors alike.

The community boasts a wide range of amenities designed to cater to diverse interests and lifestyles. It features over 1,200 hotel rooms, a vibrant marina with 170 berths, and a sprawling 65,000-square-meter aquapark. Residents and visitors can enjoy various leisure and dining options, boutique shopping, and water sports activities. The scenic lagoon and beautifully landscaped parks further add to the charm, creating a serene environment for relaxation and recreation.

Hawana Salalah is thoughtfully designed to foster a vibrant and self-sufficient community. Its freehold properties offer an attractive investment opportunity with the added benefit of residency in Oman. Whether enjoying a tranquil beachside retreat, indulging in upscale hospitality, or exploring the rich cultural heritage of Salalah, this thriving coastal destination offers a unique blend of lifestyle, leisure, and investment opportunities.
